Money basics get explained in ordinary language rather than finance jargon. It never moves money and never takes card numbers.
meal-planner: Once a weekend it works out the coming week's dinners against your budget, your household's tastes and whatever nobody will eat. The shopping list arrives in one piece, ordered by store aisle so you are not doubling back on yourself. Midweek it handles swap requests for when a plan falls apart.
bills-yo: A Coinbase crypto trade scout that hunts for small-cap setups worth the fees, proposes trades with stop-loss and take-profit, and sends a daily recap. Nothing gets placed without your approval.
air-watch: Reads your Airthings monitors every 2 hours and never changes devices, settings, or your Airthings account. Alerts go only to you, and only when a room is out of range (radon, CO2, humidity, VOC, PM2.5, temperature, battery, or stale data) or the Airthings key needs reissuing. Not a CO or smoke alarm.
allergy-friendly-eats: Remembers your food allergies and intolerances, then finds safe restaurant orders, checks labels, and plans allergy-friendly meals and grocery lists.
arnie: Dein persönlicher Fitness-Coach für Fettabbau und Muskelaufbau, jederzeit erreichbar. Rechnet deine Kalorien und Makros, plant deine Mahlzeiten und hält dich im Alltag auf Kurs.
asado-bot: Plans your asado shopping: tell it who is coming and it calculates how much meat, chorizo, and bread to buy, then tracks your progress at the supermarket. All portion rules are configurable.
author-watch: Follows the writers you care about across the sites they publish on and tells you only when they have a genuinely new article. Scans on your schedule, stays quiet when nothing's new, and can save finds to a read-later app.
baseball-score-alerts: Get MLB score alerts that often beat the TV: pings at the 4th inning, on every run, and at the final, plus a morning schedule with start times and channels.
body-of-evidence: A personal medical research and health advisor that reads lab reports, checks medications for interactions, works through symptoms, preps doctor visits, and builds evidence-based prevention and longevity plans. For anyone who wants rigorous, practical help understanding their own health.
book-maker: Turns any topic or question into a careful, well-sourced multi-chapter book, delivered as Notion pages, a PDF, or an EPUB it can email to your Kindle.
call-shield: Cuts the spam calls reaching your phone and keeps them down: Do Not Call registration, carrier and phone blockers, FTC complaint drafts, and data-broker opt-outs, all with your approval. Template by akirax.si.
celiac-scout: A restaurant safety checker for people with celiac disease or a serious gluten intolerance. Name a restaurant, chain, or menu item and it vets celiac safety from official allergen information and recent reviews, then leads with a Safe, Iffy, or Skip verdict. It never books, orders, or gives medical advice beyond cross-contact basics.
claim-ready: A VA disability claim organizer for veterans. It builds an evidence checklist for each condition, tracks intent-to-file and exam dates, helps write lay statements, and gets you ready for C&P exams, pointing you to free accredited help the whole way.
d2r-vr-helper: Helps you install, update, and fix the D2R PCVR mod so you can play Diablo II: Resurrected in VR on a Windows PC. For Quest and Steam Frame players with their own copy of the game.
duobot: Duobot helps a couple or household stay in sync. Each partner has their own Duobot, and both work from one shared Google Calendar and one shared Trello board (To Duo, Duo-ing, Done, Groceries, Bills, Gifts, Date Night, Vacation). Duobot drafts, you approve: nothing is sent, booked, or paid without your say-so. Get the image cards and avatars at duobotsi.com. Stay in sync. Let's Duo it.
edge-hunter: Finds NFL betting edges each week by matching scheme against scheme, defense first, then checks the read against the market. Sends a ranked list of plays with why each hits, why it might not, and stays quiet when nothing clears the bar.
el-licenciado: El Licenciado es tu contador personal para México. Captura tus estados de cuenta y recibos en tu hoja de Google Sheets, concilia cada mes, te dice qué gastos son deducibles y te deja lista la hoja de trabajo para tu declaración anual. Te avisa de tus fechas con el SAT, siempre verificadas en la fuente oficial. Tú decides y presentas; él hace el resto.
ernahrungscoach: A warm, practical nutrition coach that logs your meals, supplements and body values from text, voice or photos and helps you lose body fat while keeping muscle, at a gentle pace.
farm-manager: A steady, plain-spoken farm hand for a small homestead. Keeps livestock lineages and health records, the garden and orchard calendars and maps, beehive care, and rain-based watering and parasite alerts, all using extension-service guidance.
fishing-report: Fishing Report tells you when and where to fish, which technique and lures, bait, or flies to use, and whether it's worth going, for any water, salt or fresh: lakes, rivers, ponds, bays, surf, and offshore. genealogy: A family-history research assistant. It checks your family tree against original records like census, vital, military, and probate records, cites every source, and keeps organized research notes.
grokbird: Grok風オカメインコを育てる放置育成ゲームの飼育係Bot。話しかけると世話ができ、育て方で分岐進化するドット絵の鳥を毎朝報告してくれる。
group-travel-concierge-by-easygroupfligh: Plan a group trip of 8 or more people and get group airfares, plus a hotel if you need one. It collects your trip details and sends them to a group travel specialist, who replies with a real written quote.
health-helper: A patient health organizer for an older adult. It keeps medicines, appointments, and doctor-visit notes in order, reminds them on time, and helps them get ready for each visit, one plain question at a time.
jane: A teacher bot that hosts the open-source Jane learning app for your grade-school child and writes a fresh, adaptive quest every night based on how they did, built on the Marble skill taxonomy.
junk-mail-stopper: Snap a photo of any junk mail that comes to your mailbox and it files that sender's free removal, then logs every request. It asks each sender directly, the route the FTC recommends, and points you at OptOutPrescreen (you file it) and DMAchoice only if you ask. Expect removals to take 4 to 8 weeks.
lcc: LCCで安く行けるポーカー遠征を、追加料金込みの総額で比べて提案するボット。会社員のポーカープレイヤー向け。
magnum-p-i: Magnum P.I. helps you build trust by vetting websites, sellers, credentials, and dating matches using public records, then gives you a clear verdict with sources.
meal-and-savings-planner: A meal and grocery helper for busy parents. It builds weekly meal plans around your family's tastes, allergies, and budget, makes aisle-sorted grocery lists, finds coupons and deals, and tracks spending, always asking before anything is bought.
meal-planner-and-grocery-list: Plans a week of dinners that fit your diet, budget, and time, then turns them into a grocery list grouped by store section, ready to paste into a shopping helper.
notes-bot: A simple personal notepad. Toss it ideas, reminders or rambling dictated thoughts, and it saves clean, dated notes to your Google Doc and pings you when reminders are due.
number-guard: Cuts down spam calls by finding your phone number on people-search and data broker sites and submitting free opt-outs you approve, then re-checking monthly.
one-day: “One day I’ll start.” One Day turns it into the first step and a daily check until you do it. Draft only — it never files, pays, posts, or calls.
overheard-2: 每天定时给你一份合并早报：你在 X 上关注的人说了什么、按你关心的领域排好，可每天存进 Notion 或 Obsidian。适合想少刷 X、不漏重点的人。
pc-helper: Hands-on helper that actually does the work on your Windows PC and home network: tune-ups, drivers, cleanup, clean uninstalls, network fixes, and mic and voice tuning, always scanning first, asking before changes, and giving you the undo. Say "show me what you can do" anytime for the full list.
pc-mechanic: A friendly mechanic for your Windows PC or Mac: read-only checkups scored out of 100, app installs and uninstalls from official sources, cleanup, faster startup, and a custom look. It asks before every change, makes a safety point first, and logs every fix with a one-line undo.
personal-dj: Your personal DJ: name a mood, genre, or activity and get a one-click YouTube playlist of real, verified tracks.
privacy-scrub: Keeps your phone numbers and email addresses off people-search sites, caller-ID and email-lookup databases, business contact databases, and marketing lists. It files only free opt-outs a few times a year and reports what's removed, waiting, or stuck.
profesor-tesla: Tu profesor personal de la Academia Einstein: 4 años desde cero en tecnología, IA y ciencia, con clases diarias en el chat, quizzes, proyectos y certificados. Classes in English or Spanish.
scam-guard: Scans your Gmail or Outlook inbox twice a day for phishing and scam emails, labels the suspects, and tells you why. Label-only: it never deletes, moves, or replies, and it never calls anything safe.
shop-bot-2: A personal shopper that finds restocks, new finds, and gifts, scans your X shopping bookmarks for the best trustworthy prices, and only buys on your explicit yes.
socrates: Like Grok, Socrates searched for truth, and he helps you find it in life too. Bring him a half-baked idea and he restates it in its strongest form, asks the questions that expose the weak spot, and only changes his mind when you give him a better argument. Built for anyone who wants a sparring partner for the truth, not a yes-man.
spam-call-scrubber: Finds your phone number on people-search sites and data brokers, submits the opt-outs, finishes the email confirmations, and re-checks on the schedule you choose. Asks only for the minimum details it needs.
the-maitre-d: Finds great restaurants and books your reservations. Tell it the night, party size, area, and vibe, and it brings back 4 picks with booking and map links, then locks in your table.
tv-de-ad-bot: Removes ads, tracking, and clutter from your own smart TV with safe, reversible steps you approve one at a time. Best on Google TV, Android TV, and Fire TV; privacy and DNS help for every brand.
tv-tamer: Debloats, de-ads, speeds up and customizes your own Android TV or Google TV over ADB from a computer on your home network. It backs everything up, asks before each change, and only uses reversible methods.
undercut: Drop in a bill. See what new customers pay near you, plus the exact script to get your price down. You make the call.
x-bookmark-top10: Every morning, sends you the 10 most-bookmarked X posts on your topic from the last 24 hours, each summarized in a sentence with a link. Flags scams. Read-only, no X sign-in needed.
x-bookmarks-daily: Reads your X bookmarks, likes, and For You feed every day and sends a themed summary with a chart plus a rated report of every outside link shared. Read-only: it never likes or posts.
bot-30: 年収と家族構成から控除上限の目安を出し、予算内で人気の返礼品を探して比較。年末の締切やワンストップ特例の期限もリマインドします。寄付・決済は代行しません。
bot-31: Xで話題のお店とレシピを毎日集めて、Notionに整理するボットです。一般の人の投稿も重視し、Notionに貯めたお店やレシピは聞けば検索して教えてくれます。
bot-33: お住まいの自治体の公式ゴミ収集日を調べて、毎晩「明日は何ゴミの日か」を知らせるボット。「これ何ゴミ？」にも公式の分け方で答えます。
bot-34: Amazon・楽天・Yahoo!の欲しい物を目標価格とポイント還元込みで見張り、値下がりや大型キャンペーンの時だけ知らせるボット。購入は代行しません。
bot-35: 推しのチケット抽選、グッズ発売、出演情報を毎朝まとめて、締切が近い順にお知らせするボット。申込や購入は代行しません。
bot-37: 家族の人数・予算・調理時間に合わせて1週間の献立と売り場別の買い物リストを毎週届けるボット。好き嫌いを覚えてだんだん好みに合わせます。
bot-38: 무신사와 카카오 선물하기 체험단을 매일 확인해서 조건에 맞는 공고에 대신 신청하고, 당첨 결과까지 알려주는 봇이에요.
